subject: spanish
title: Stamp 1: La Transicion
welcome_lead: Stamp Spain's peaceful transition from dictatorship to democracy.
meta_desc: A-Level Spanish adventure on the Transition 1975-1978 and the 1978 Constitution.

concepts.def: Spanish Transition 1975-1978 from Franco dictatorship to parliamentary democracy.
King after Franco's death (1975-2014); supported the transition to democracy.
Prime minister 1976-1981 who led the political transition.
1976 Political Reform Law dismantling Franco's institutions.
Constitution approved by referendum on 6 December 1978.
Failed coup attempt of 23 February 1981 led by Tejero, halted by the King's broadcast.

walkthroughs.body_html: Franco died on 20 November 1975. Juan Carlos I, designated successor, surprised many by backing democratisation rather than continuing authoritarian rule.
The Constitution declared Spain a parliamentary monarchy with a social and democratic state of law. It established a system of autonomous communities, balancing unity and regional identity.
On 23 February 1981, Lieutenant Colonel Tejero stormed the Cortes. The King's televised broadcast that night demanded loyalty to the Constitution; the coup collapsed by the next morning.
